en.headline: Mother placed on three-year bond after child neglect charge dropped
en.dek: Prosecutors at West Kowloon Court dropped a child abuse charge against a 53-year-old woman earlier this month after her 12-year-old daughter lost four kilograms in a month in 2023.
body: A 53-year-old housewife accused of neglecting her chronically underweight daughter has been spared trial after prosecutors agreed to a three-year good behaviour bond order, according to the South China Morning Post.

The South China Morning Post reported that the charge was dropped earlier this month at West Kowloon Court. The girl’s weight fell from 24.9 kilograms to 20.9 kilograms between March and April 2023, leaving her about eight kilograms below the third percentile for her age at the time.

The girl, who had been underweight since the age of six and was placed on a feeding tube in hospital in 2021, was 12 at the time of the recent report. The mother admitted that she sometimes failed to follow medical advice to feed her daughter three times a day.
The Department of Justice has said that public interest is generally a key factor in decisions of this kind. The case did not proceed to a full trial.

zh.headline: 母親虐兒控罪撤銷 簽三年守行為三年
zh.dek: 西九龍裁判法院本月較早時撤銷一名53歲女子的虐兒控罪，換取她同意簽下三年守行為令，涉事女兒於2023年一個月內體重下降四公斤。
body: 一名被指忽略長期體重不足女兒的53歲家庭主婦，在控方同意簽下三年守行為令後毋須受審，《南華早報》報道。
《南華早報》指，控罪於本月較早時在西九龍裁判法院撤銷。女童於2023年3月至4月期間體重由24.9公斤跌至20.9公斤，當時低於同齡第三百分位約八公斤。
女童自六歲起體重偏低，2021年曾住院接受餵食管治療，報道時年十二歲。母親承認有時未能遵從醫生建議每日餵食三次。
律政司表示，公眾利益一般是這類決定的關鍵考慮因素。案件並無進入全面審訊。
